name: divine revelation

phase_0.boundary_condition: The absolute transcendence of the Godhead which contains all possible emanations.

VINIT.justification: The pre-revelatory state of divine silence before any word or light emerges.

TANCH.justification: The ultimate closure of history where the revelation is fully realized and the system is sealed.

AFWD.justification: The outward movement of divine light from the source toward the created world.

AREV.justification: The return of the mind from the created image back to the formless source through negation.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of prophetic messages into a coherent historical lineage.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential identity where the speaker and the spoken word are identical.

FSPLIT.justification: The single divine truth branching into the duality of Law and Mercy.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of Law and Mercy into the singular presence of the Godhead.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative reception and acceptance of the revealed truth.

EVALF.justification: The rejection or failure to recognize the divine signal.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of the hidden and the manifest held in tension.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the revelation into an unchangeable written record.

phase_3.void_description: The primordial silence before the first creative utterance.
phase_3.true_description: The state of illumination where the soul aligns with the divine will.
phase_3.false_description: The state of darkness or occlusion where the revelation is obscured.
phase_3.both_description: The state of theophany where the infinite occupies the finite space.

steps.domain_action: The unmanifest Godhead exists in absolute silence.
The Godhead recognizes itself as the source of all being.
The divine will initiates the process of self-disclosure.
The singular light of truth divides into the dualities of the created order.
The prophet receives the affirmative command of the Law.
The Law is transmitted to the community as a guiding path.
The community offers prayer as a return of the word to the source.
The community encounters the limitations and failures of the flesh.
The failure necessitates a descent into repentance.
Law and Mercy converge in the act of divine forgiveness.
The believer holds the paradox of being simultaneously a sinner and justified.
The experience is linked to the historical record of previous revelations.
The revelation is inscribed into the eternal book as a permanent witness.
The revelation reaches its completion in the final restoration of all things.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit which translates divine intent into human language.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Prayer and ritual which facilitate communication between the human and the divine.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The collective memory of the faithful and the physical archives of scripture.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Providence which determines the timing of prophetic interventions.
phase_5.alfs_store: The primordial tablet or the mind of God containing the archetypes of all revelation.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The sacrifice of the ego and the physical energy of the prophet.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A state of spiritual thirst or lack of direction.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A state of spiritual saturation and established order.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy expended in revelation is recovered in the restoration of the soul to its source.
